assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, NEBNext Ultra II Directional, PE151) of whole cerebellum; STAR 2.7.10a GeneCounts on GRCm39 (S1.8.p2-p3)

treatment: voluntary wheel running 4-16 weeks of age

sample_inclusion: n = 3 per group, 4 groups (S3 limitations: 'n = 3/group'); 12 GEO samples; male and female littermates (S1.1.p1), sex per sample not given
primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks voluntary wheel running on cerebellar gene expression: WT exercise vs WT sedentary (549 DEGs), and within SCA1 mice SCA exercise vs SCA sedentary; plus genotype effect (SCA sedentary vs WT sedentary) and SCA exercise vs WT sedentary for rescue analysis (S2.5.p1, Fig 5)
planned_contrasts: WT exercise vs WT sedentary (S2.5.p1; paper: 549 DEGs)
SCA sedentary vs WT sedentary (S2.5.p1: 76 DEGs; Fig 5C legend: 79 DEGs)
SCA exercise vs WT sedentary (Fig 5A/5C; count not stated)
SCA exercise vs SCA sedentary (S2.5.p1: Calb1/Trpc3 p-adj > 0.99; count not stated, 'minimal')
paper_method: DESeq2 1.46.0 pairwise group comparisons (S1.8.p3); exact model/formula not stated
paper_results: 549 DEGs WT ex vs WT sed; 76/79 DEGs SCA sed vs WT sed; Calb1 log2FC -0.825 padj 0.0019 and Trpc3 log2FC -0.669 padj 0.013 in SCA sed vs WT sed; exercise in SCA minimal
